name: Chili Salmon Tacos with Orange-Avocado Slaw, Cilantro & Lime Crema

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
6 oranges
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the limes into a small bowl. Add yogurt and salt; stir to combine the crema and set aside. (Reserve remaining limes for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place oil and spices in large bowl, then stir to combine the spice oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
2 tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels. Cut into 1-inch thick fingers and add to the bowl with the spice oil. Stir to coat, then transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in a clean large bowl.
Juice reserved limes into the bowl with the onion, then add oil and salt. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with the broccoli slaw, and gently stir to combine.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with salmon and a small portion of slaw; drizzle with lime crema. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
